note: The only list of what the site publishes. A campaign's runs are read from results/<id>/ (its campaign.json and one directory per run); a campaign published before campaigns existed names its one run directory instead. results/dev is never published. Add "featured": "<id>" to choose the campaign the site opens on; without it, the site opens on the newest complete campaign (D58).

campaigns.title: Baseline
campaigns.question: How many microVMs fit on one m8i.4xlarge?
notes: Tasks start as soon as every microVM is ready.

campaigns.title: Metal host
notes: Its SLO is looser than the nested campaigns': each step's p50 within 2 s and p95 within 3 s, not 1 s and 2 s.
Every density passed. A host runs at most 200 microVMs in this harness, so the limit is above 192.

campaigns.title: Metal, nested SLO
notes: The same SLO as the nested campaigns: each step's p50 within 1 s and p95 within 2 s.
Densities are close together between 128 and 144, around where hv-host-2's trials would have crossed this SLO.
